stories.story_title: DFFP infrared drone deployed on Mastadon Fire near Talkeetna, 100% containment in <72h
stories.summary: DFFP UAS Module sent infrared drone to Mastadon Fire (#131) near Talkeetna 9:30AM June 5; located residual heat inside 18.4-acre perimeter guiding crews; 100% contained 1:11PM June 5. Second infrared flight scheduled next morning to verify. Standard DFFP detect-and-verify protocol.
stories.consequence: Wildfire ops: DFFP UAS module proven; procurement decision on expanding module staffing before July-Aug peak.

stories.story_title: XPRIZE $11M autonomous wildfire finals, NANA region mid-June 2026
stories.summary: 5 finalists (Anduril, Data Blanket, Dryad, FireSwarm Solutions, Wildfire Quest) to compete in 1,000 sq km of NANA Region mid-June 2026; AI drone swarms must autonomously detect+suppress fire within 10 min. UAF ACUASI is testing partner. $11M XPRIZE; PG&E $1M bonus.
stories.consequence: Aviation/wildfire: ACUASI=domestic certification pathway; 2026-2028 procurement cycle.

stories.story_title: AI targeting platforms in AK mineral exploration as summer field season opens
stories.summary: June 5 op-ed North of 60 Mining News (J.P. Tangen): KoBold (Skolai nickel, Interior AK), VerAI, GeologicAI, Scanminers using AI/ML over geophysical data + drill-core scanning for 2026 field season.
stories.consequence: Mining exploration: AI compresses target-gen; junior explorers/ANCs decision.

stories.story_title: UAF/AOOS autonomous gliders surveying Gulf of Alaska through summer 2026
stories.summary: 3 AUV gliders (Shackleton, Blinky, Turbo) UAF+AOOS surveying GoA shelf thru June 2026; Blinky has 200kHz acoustics fish finder + plankton cam, near-real-time to AOOS Ocean Data Explorer. NPFMC met June 1.
stories.consequence: Fisheries: real-time data into in-season stock assessments.
